member.name: T:Sentinel.Keycloak.Dpop.KeycloakDpopProofFactory
member.summary: Creates RFC 9449 DPoP proofs for the Sentinel runtime's own token-endpoint calls (client_credentials, UMA ticket, token exchange, refresh). Keycloak's realm client policy requires a DPoP proof on every token request, so each outbound token call is signed with the shared process proof key (PS256, the FAPI 2.0 baseline algorithm).
